# Loid — Ankush Das · Full-Stack Developer & Systems Enthusiast

> Official portfolio of Ankush Das (Løid), Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer at Sednium Technologies. This is a single-page portfolio covering professional experience, flagship open-source architecture projects, skills, and direct contact channels.

Ankush Das is a full-stack developer and systems engineer based in West Bengal, India. He co-founded Sednium Technologies and works across the full stack — accessible web interfaces in React and TypeScript, high-performance backend services in Go and Node.js, mobile-native systems, and cryptographic/edge infrastructure. The content below is the canonical summary of https://loid.sednium.com/.

## Projects

- [OnyxChat](https://onyxchat.sednium.com): Local-first Android encrypted messaging client built on the S.H.I.E.L.D. protocol, with stateless routing and hardware-backed storage.
- [Blade Launcher](https://blade-launcher.sednium.com/): Next-generation mobile launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition on Android with isolated Java 8–26 runtimes and multi-renderer graphics.
- [S.H.I.E.L.D. Protocol](https://sednium.com/shield): Six-layer zero-knowledge messaging architecture with hybrid post-quantum cryptography, forward secrecy, and routing anonymity.
- [KryptonIDE](https://kryptonide.sednium.com): Native Android integrated development environment with incremental parsing and an integrated PTY terminal bridge.
- [Sednicon](https://sednicon.sednium.com): Automated SVG optimization and cross-platform iconography delivery API.
